plugin.name: Wbcom Designs - BuddyPress Contact Me
plugin.license: EDD SL SDK 1.0.4-wbcom.3 (libs/edd-sl-sdk), registered in buddypress-contact-me.php; licence screen in edd-license/edd-plugin-license.php

endpoints.permission: __return_true (gated by nonce + captcha + BCM_Frontend_Nav::viewer_can_send role allow-list)
endpoints.purpose: Submit a new contact message (logged-in or anonymous with captcha)
Delete a message owned by the requesting user
Mark the inbox intro panel as dismissed for the current user (sets bcm_intro_dismissed usermeta)

admin_pages.title: WB Plugins
admin_pages.note: Shared top-level hub; first Wbcom plugin to load creates it

settings.controls: Main settings (array): bcm_allow_notification, bcm_allow_email, bcm_allow_admin_copy_email, bcm_allow_sender_copy_email, bcm_allow_contact_tab, bcm_who_contact (role allow-list of senders), bcm_who_contacted (role allow-list of recipients)
EDD license key; also the SDK registration option_name, so updates use it
License status (active|invalid|expired|...) - managed via EDD API
License expiration date - managed via EDD API
Per-user opt-out. Only 'off' blocks contact; absent means accepts. Saved only from Contact > Preferences (BCM_Frontend_Nav::screen_preferences); the Settings > General copy was removed in 1.5.1.
Per-user flag: inbox intro panel dismissed
Licence status written by the SDK's own plugin-row Manage License overlay (SDK-managed, not read by the plugin)

shortcodes.purpose: Render the contact form for a specific member (by user ID or login)

tables.name: {prefix}contact_me
tables.purpose: Stores contact-form submissions (both logged-in and anonymous)
schema_columns: sender (int, sender user ID; 0 for anonymous)
reciever (int, recipient user ID) [sic: column name misspelled in schema]
name (varchar 255, sender name for anonymous submissions)
email (varchar 255, sender email for anonymous submissions)
datetime (varchar 255, UTC 'Y-m-d H:i:s' since 1.5.1; read via BCM_Messages_Repo::timestamp())

hooks_fired.name: bp_core_template_plugin
hooks_fired.note: BuddyPress core hook; fired 3 times (inbox, preferences, send screens)

buddypress_integration.buddyboss_compat: Detects BBoss via isset(buddypress()->buddyboss); switches user-slug retrieval between bp_members_get_user_slug and bp_core_get_username accordingly
buddypress_integration.bp_email: Uses BP email system; BCM_Email_Installer creates three BP email posts on activation/upgrade: bcm-contact-message (recipient), bcm-contact-message-sender-copy, bcm-contact-message-admin-copy. One bp_send_email() call per reader.

security.anonymous_submission_gate: Guests: role allow-list (Visitors), honeypot field bcm_website, one-time captcha or CAPTCHA Manager, per-IP throttle. Members: viewer_can_send() role allow-list + per-user throttle. Sender copy email only to logged-in senders; member account email never displayed.

static_analysis.wppqa_findings_2026_05_11: 5 high-severity nonce-no-cap (2x EDD license activate/deactivate, 2x frontend submit handler — public path, intentional; the role gate is BCM_Frontend_Nav::viewer_can_send not current_user_can, 1x preferences tab — own-profile only). 1 low tap-target warning (admin.css:556). wiring-completeness skipped (no templates/ dir). rest-js-contract clean.
static_analysis.note_1_5_1: 1.5.1: wppqa findings above are from 2026-05-11 and predate the 1.5.1 rewrite (loader, flash class and settings-general toggle removed). Re-run the baseline at release.

generated.delta_1_5_1: Manual delta 2026-11-18 on branch 1.5.1: hooks, transients, integrations, entry-point exception, privacy note.

transients.purpose: One-time guest math answer; deleted when the message is saved (replay guard).
Per-sender send counter (filter bcm_rate_limit, default 5 per 600 s).

hooks_consumed.name: reign_bp_nav_icons
hooks_consumed.purpose: Reign theme subnav icons for contact, inbox, send, preferences.

hooks_consumed.name: deleted_user / wpmu_delete_user
hooks_consumed.purpose: Delete messages the user received, 500 per query.

hooks_consumed.name: bp_init
hooks_consumed.purpose: Version router: schema, one-time UTC conversion, email install.

hooks_consumed.name: edd_sl_sdk_registry
hooks_consumed.callback: closure (registers buddypress-contact-me: url BUDDYPRESS_CONTACT_ME_LICENCE_HOST, fallback_url https://wbcomdesigns.com, item_id 1528584)

captcha_manager.purpose: When active with a service on, guests get the site CAPTCHA instead of the math question.

edd_sl_sdk.sdk: libs/edd-sl-sdk 1.0.4-wbcom.3 (registers as 1.0.4.3, vendored byte-identical; never patch)
edd_sl_sdk.helper: buddypress_contact_me_licence_request( array $params ): object|false - every activate/deactivate/check goes through it (edd_BCM_call_api maps false to the 'Could not reach the license server' WP_Error)

entry_point_exceptions.frontend: member inbox, single view, delete; contact form + shortcode
entry_point_exceptions.exception: Owner decision (1.5.1): no admin message list and no REST list endpoint. Messages are private between members; site owners moderate through the admin copy email.

privacy.user_deletion: Messages the user received are deleted on deleted_user / wpmu_delete_user; messages they sent stay with recipients. BP removes their notifications.
privacy.exporters_erasers: Not registered (out of scope for 1.5.1, owner decision). Add wp_privacy_personal_data_exporters / erasers if a GDPR request flow is needed.
